acoustic_triggered_duty_cycle.operational_mechanism: Drone cruises in low-power acoustic surveillance mode with camera sampling at 2 FPS (reducing compute load by 93%). Upon verified emergency vocalization ('বাঁচাও'), the flight controller triggers camera burst mode (25 FPS) and engages local spiral tracking. This extends mission endurance from 18 minutes to ~68 minutes on a standard 4S LiPo battery.

scheduling_and_power_analysis.drone_deployment_qualification: Cautionary Rule Enforced: Real-time autonomous drone flight must not be claimed until end-to-end hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) flight test establishes vibration tolerance, wind gusts, and onboard power stability.
